def cohens_kappa(labels1, labels2, common_ids):
    y1 = [labels1[tid] for tid in common_ids]
    y2 = [labels2[tid] for tid in common_ids]
    n = len(common_ids)
    
    # Raw agreement
    agree = sum(1 for a, b in zip(y1, y2) if a == b)
    po = agree / n
    
    # Expected agreement
    cats = sorted(set(y1) | set(y2))
    pe = sum((y1.count(c)/n) * (y2.count(c)/n) for c in cats)
    
    kappa = (po - pe) / (1 - pe) if pe < 1 else 0
    return po, kappa, n

def collapsed_kappa(labels1, labels2, common_ids):
    """Collapse SM and SC into SM_SC"""
    def collapse(label):
        return 'SM_SC' if label in ('SM', 'SC') else label
    
    y1 = [collapse(labels1[tid]) for tid in common_ids]
